verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own Audio Intelligence feature generates AI insights from the user's audio data: summarization, sentiment analysis, topic detection, and intent recognition. However, the evidence is a single one-line docs mention, and nothing shows suggestions or recommendations, or an in-product experience beyond API output. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions/recommendations, an in-product insights surface beyond the API, in-depth documentation of the insight features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Audio Intelligence: Summarization, sentiment analysis, topic detection, and intent recognition
